propositions: A class configured with a fallback array should build a FallbackModel wrapper whose default is the primary model entry and fallbacks are inline model configs

Errors classified into _RETRYABLE or CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL should trigger failover to the next model in the chain, while errors like 401/403 and context-length failures propagate without attempting fallback
All sub-models in a fallback chain must be entered and exited through a shared ProviderSession async context manager, with each client closed exactly once
Capabilities for a fallback chain must be computed as the conservative intersection over all candidate models, never by calling capabilities_for on the FallbackModel wrapper itself
The ran_model field in provider_provenance must be read from ModelResponse.model_name (the actual responding model) rather than from FallbackModel.model_name (which returns a synthetic string)
A 429 error with insufficient_quota classifies as INCREASE_PROVIDER_LIMITS and does not trigger fallback, while a plain 429 rate-limit classifies as WAIT_AND_RETRY and does trigger fallback
